property_description:
• Premier, central Financial District location
  • Local, responsive ownership
  • Has been recently updated with new lobby, elevator cab, outdoor planter boxes, signage and exterior paint job

580 Market Street is located in the center of the Financial District at the gateway to the vibrant Second Street Corridor running from Market Street through SoMa to AT&T Park. The location benefits from Second Street Corridor creative office space demand and Market Street retail rent premium. The seven story, 33,000 square foot office and retail building is anchored by GNC and QuiznoÕs on the ground floor and mix of creative and traditional office tenants on the upper 4,500 square foot floors.
Full floor opportunity. Nice mix of private offices and open plan.

Industrial poured in place concrete building that underwent 3 million dollar renovation during the dot.com boom. Entire building is on card key access. It's a short walk to AT&T Park, N Judah line, South Park and more.
